title: Reference Route
description: Definition of a reference route for speed climbing

reference.description: File name of the official route plan in docs/reference-routes/

columns.description: Column coordinate system: 11 letters defining columns A-K position mapping. Predefined: ABC=ABCDEFGHIJK (default), FFME=ABCDEFGHIKL, IFSC=ABCDEFGHILM

color.description: Hold colors: either a single hex color, or a map of tag -> hex color whose FIRST key is the default applied to untagged holds

holds.description: List of holds in compact format

items.description: Hold definition: PANEL TYPE POSITION ORIENTATION followed by up to three optional tokens in any order: SCALE, @LABEL, #COLORTAG. Column letters must match the declared coordinate system. Rows are integer inserts (1-10) but may be fractional (e.g. F5.1) to nudge a hold vertically between inserts. The color tag must be a key of the route's color map.

smearingZones.description: Smearing zones (areas for friction-based foot placements on the wall surface)

smearingZone.description: A rectangular zone where climbers can use friction-based foot placements

label.description: Zone identifier displayed on the plan (e.g., 'Z1', 'Zone A')

panel.description: Panel identifier where the zone starts (e.g., 'DX1', 'SN3')

column.description: Column letter for the bottom-left corner (A-M)

columnOffset.description: Horizontal offset from the column in insert units (e.g., 0.5 = half column to the right)

row.description: Row number for the bottom-left corner (can be decimal, e.g., 4.5 = between rows 4 and 5)

width.description: Width in insert units (e.g., 2.5 = 2.5 column spacings)

height.description: Height in insert units (e.g., 4.0 = 4 row spacings, can span panels)

colorTag.description: Key of the route's color map. Defaults to the route's first declared color.
